title: Batch GeoJSON and KML Import
negative_results: a root that is not a FeatureCollection is refused
a non-Point geometry (LineString/Polygon) is refused by this points importer
missing or short coordinate arrays are refused
an out-of-range or non-finite latitude/longitude is refused
malformed KML XML and a Placemark without a Point are refused
a private token in a point label is refused

claims.statement: A batch of points round-trips points->GeoJSON->points and points->KML->points; GeoJSON uses [lon,lat,height] axis order; every export (GeoJSON/KML/CSV) carries body, frame (CRS), and epoch; ordering is preserved and output is deterministic (POWER).
Points encode to CW-GEO-1 vectors via the existing reversible codec; the round-trip is a property of the codec, not a geographic claim.
Malformed or underdetermined interchange input is a typed refusal.

privacy_check: CLEAN - pure-Python parsers, synthetic points only, labels privacy-scanned, no shapely/GDAL
